shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '.git/' | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md

cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json index.html; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup useTheme Switch; grep -n -i -C 4 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup Text Flex 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build 2>/dev/null; find . -name '*.d.ts' -path '*theme*' | grep -v node_modules | head -20; find . -name '*.d.ts' -path '*SegmentedRadioGroup*' | head; grep -n -i -C3 'theme' README.md | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts theme/types.d.ts theme/useThemeValue.d.ts theme/useTheme.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; grep -n "variant\|TEXT_VARIANTS" Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls Text
grep -n -A 20 'interface ControlGroupProps' types.d.ts; grep -n 'gap\|direction\|alignItems' layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head
